messages:
taylor: Following up on the DR postmortem: we sketched remediation buckets. Need one-line owners + ETAs so I can lock the tracker. Areas: backups verification, restore runbook clarity, multi-region routing playbook, and a rehearsal (game day).

mira: Please include exact Route53 / DNS commands in the runbook (we lost time last failover). Also call out TTL expectations.

jordan: I'll run full snapshot restores from us/eu into staging and attach smoke verification commands. Target: Wed EOD.

casey: I'll revise the restore runbook to include step-by-step restore commands, verification queries, and a short rollback section. ETA Fri.

zane: I will own the routing playbook changes and the canary plan. Proposal: 3% weight shift for 20m, monitor 1m error rate, auto-rollback on >0.5%. I'll post the change script and the alert hook.

sylvia: I'll add these to the incident tracker and create weekly rotation reminders. Link will be posted once updated.

taylor: Action summary: backups -> jordan (Wed EOD); runbook edits -> casey (Fri); routing canary -> zane (coordinate ops); tracker/reminders -> sylvia (today). If no objections I'll mark owners in the tracker.

mira: I'm available as secondary for routing during the game day.

ops-bot: Reminder: DR rehearsal scheduled Sat 09:00 UTC. RSVP in calendar.
